messages.subject: error in name(sphere data)
parts:
Hi GGIR users


I can happily run Axivity (.CWA) files, however when working with ActiGraph .csv files, all I receive is the following error


Error in names(spheredata) <- c("Euclidean Norm", "meanx", "meany", "meanz",  : 
  'names' attribute [8] must be the same length as the vector [7]
